automation.n8nWorkflow: Bitkub price alerts → Mavis paper decision

executiveNotes: Paper-only. No real exchange orders are authorized or executed.
Audit: the old V1 high-risk bot really did rotate ~30k ADA because it was configured to trade 95% of holdings/cash. That was too aggressive for the intended small-increment test.
V1 state/trades were archived locally; V2 has restarted from initial paper holdings: 331 XRP reserve, 500 XRP active, 28,794 ADA, 0 THB cash.
V2 rule: only one planned position at a time, max 100 XRP or 500 ADA per new paper position, with target/stop shown in the Trade List.
The 30k ADA V1 churn was real paper output from an overly broad 95% rotation setting. It has been archived and superseded by V2 small-increment planned positions.
Paper treasury allocation executed at 2026-06-01 14:03 UTC: 1500 ADA → BTC, ETH, THB (500 ADA each bucket) at market prices.
